description: This file defines the Customer controller class for the Opencart admin dashboard extension. It manages the display of customer statistics, configuration settings, and related actions within the admin panel.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer dashboard widget and settings in Opencart admin.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets page title, prepares data for the dashboard widget view, including breadcrumbs, configuration, and layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the dashboard configuration settings; checks permissions, updates settings, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Generates customer statistics data for display, including total customers and percentage change, and renders the customer info view.
